scripts.test: bun test packages apps/playground apps/my-api apps/my-app apps/my-saas apps/my-live apps/my-react apps/my-vue apps/my-svelte templates/api templates/views templates/live templates/react templates/vue templates/svelte templates/saas
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p packages/contracts --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/common --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/container --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/config --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/http --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/router --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/core --noEmit
